name: EquiliCat - Hugues Martinat - Comportementaliste Chat
short_description: Feline behaviour consultations, addressing cohabitation issues and in-home guidance in Paris.
short_description_local: Consultations de comportement félin, gestion des conduites gênantes et suivi à domicile à Paris.
description: EquiliCat is a feline behaviour practice led by Hugues Martinat in Paris. Consultations address unwanted behaviours including aggression, litter box avoidance, nocturnal meowing, and cohabitation difficulties between cats. Sessions are conducted in home or remotely with 3 months of follow-up support.

Les séances se déroulent à domicile ou à distance avec un suivi de 3 mois.
